title: Affine coefficient section base change
statement: Let f:X to T be separated, F a quasi-coherent module sheaf on X, U an affine open of T, and V_i a finite family of affine opens of f inverse image U. Let g:Tprime to U, gprime:Xprime to X and fprime:Xprime to Tprime form a cartesian square with f and g followed by the inclusion of U. Put W_i=gprime inverse image of the image of V_i under the inclusion of f inverse image U in X; put Y=f inverse image U, G the global-ring presheaf underlying F restricted to Y [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let H be the composite of restriction of scalars along GammaSpecIso followed by the map of f restricted to U, tilde over Gamma(U,O), pullback along the canonical affine chart U to Spec Gamma(U,O), and pullback along g [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model]. For each natural p and increasing tuple t, the sections on every B of H(G(intersection V_t)) are additively equivalent to the sections of M=gprime pullback F on intersection W_t intersect fprime inverse image B. These coefficient equivalences commute with restrictions of B, turn the Gamma(B,O) action into multiplication by the restricted fprime pullback of scalars, and commute with each single face restriction. No products, complexes, or differential sums occur.

proof.text: Separatedness over affine U makes every nonempty finite intersection Z of the V_i affine. Apply the affine intersection base-change statement to Z. Its base change has an affine map to Tprime, hence its inverse image over affine B is affine. The given equations for W identify this inverse image with intersection W_t intersect fprime inverse image B.

On affine B use the affine pullback section comparison for F restricted to Z. Both its base-changed coefficient sections and the sections of H(G(Z)) identify with Gamma(B,O) tensor over Gamma(U,O) Gamma(Z,F). The ring maps from GammaSpecIso and the canonical affine chart are the same structural maps. Tensor associativity identifies the two presentations; the comparison sends b tensor s to b times the pullback of s. Its inverse comes from the bijective affine pullback comparison.

Naturality of the pullback unit and restriction functor gives compatibility on pure tensors under restriction of B and of Z to a smaller affine intersection. Multiplication on the first tensor factor gives the local scalar formula. Extend the equations by additivity to every tensor. On overlaps restrict to affine basis subopens; the equations give agreement of the maps and their inverses. The sheaf gluing axiom gives maps and inverse maps on all B; their identities and the three equations are sheaf-local and therefore hold there. Empty coefficient intersections give zero sections. When r=0 or p+1 exceeds r there is no tuple, so no coefficient to construct.

theorem finiteAffineCech_coefficient_baseChange {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    [IsSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {r : ℕ}
    (V : Fin r → (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ i, W₀ i = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ V i.down)) :
    let G := (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).presheafModuleCat
    let H := ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)).inv ≫
        ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.toScheme.toSpecΓ).appTop).hom) ⋙
      tilde.functor Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ⋙
      Modules.pullback U.toScheme.toSpecΓ ⋙ Modules.pullback g
    let M := (Modules.pullback g').obj F
    ∃ c : ∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r) (B : T'.Opens),
      Γ(H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t))), B) ≃+
        Γ(M, alternatingCechIntersection (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) t ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B),
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r) {B C : T'.Opens} (i : B ⟶ C)
        (s : Γ(H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t))), C)),
        c p t B ((H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t)))).presheaf.map
          i.op s) = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf le_rfl
            ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f'.base).map i).le)).op (c p t C s)) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r) (B : T'.Opens) (b : Γ(T', B))
        (s : Γ(H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t))), B)),
        c p t B (b • s) =
          X'.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show
            alternatingCechIntersection (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) t ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B
              from inf_le_right)).op (f'.app B b) • c p t B s) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 2) ↪o Fin r) (j : Fin (p + 2)) (B : T'.Opens)
        (s : Γ(H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V
          ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)))), B)),
        c (p + 1) t B
          ((H.map (G.map (homOfLE
            (alternatingCechIntersection_face_le V p t j)).op)).app B s) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf
            (alternatingCechIntersection_face_le (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) p t j) le_rfl)).op
              (c p ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t) B s))
